'''Brandon Allen DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brandon Allen]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-7497">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7497 DeckTech post 7497], DeckTech (Brandon "Sundevil" Allen, 12 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7497/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7497/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018162231/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7497/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Nudity  Sex  and things illegal in 48 states'''
* '''Author:''' Brandon "Sundevil" Allen
* '''Published:''' June 12, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' It's Dark Space.

=== Strategy ===

Oota Goota Solo is in there to cancel Kessel Run, not for nabrum leids. Abd crush is in there not for evader, but to cancel clash so my presence stays on table
